unit_of_observation: One order/product line. Row ID uniquely identifies an order-line record; this is not one row per order.
transformations: None. No columns or rows were filtered, renamed, merged, or changed when copying this existing course CSV.
orders_count_note: Order ID is absent from this 9-column course CSV. len(df) counts order lines, not orders; do not label this count as Orders.

metrics.Sales: Sum Sales across selected order lines.
metrics.Profit: Sum Profit across selected order lines. Negative values represent losses and are retained.
metrics.Profit Margin: sum(Profit) / sum(Sales), if sum(Sales) != 0; not the average of line-level ratios.

geography_note: This is Global Superstore, not US-only Superstore. Region includes 13 global labels; Country is available.
source_context: Existing local course extract. The orders sheets in superstore.xlsx and 2026_Fall/Data/superstore.xlsx have the same 51,290 Row IDs and date values; selected numeric differences from CSV are only floating-point roundoff (<5e-13). No Excel join is required.
